items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: And Mr. TischeaeR told me that he was a very fine guitarist, so I heard him and taken him right after we opened.

ctx.x: And I came to Paris and I had taken a French trombone player. We had lost the guitarist. /He had said he didn't care to go to Germany, so I had taken another guitar player, which I changed right in Berlin, because there was an American boy in Los Angeles, Dickstein was the name. He was in Berlin.
And Mr. TischeaeR told me that he was a very fine guitarist, so I heard him and taken him right after we opened.
